purpose: Define stable logical backend aliases separately from concrete provider/model bindings so q/qc/qt and other runtime callers bind to explicit aliases rather than embedding provider-specific semantics.

topics.name: Backend Aliases
topics.purpose: Define stable logical backend aliases separately from concrete provider/model bindings so q/qc/qt and other runtime callers bind to explicit aliases rather than embedding provider-specific semantics.

semantics.alias_rule: Alias is stable logical identity separate from provider/model endpoint.
semantics.binding_rule: Changing a concrete backend binding does not change caller semantic identity when behavior remains compatible.
semantics.queue_rule: Runtime queues are keyed by resolved backend alias.
semantics.fallback_rule: Backend fallback must be explicit; silent provider/model substitution is forbidden.
semantics.response_rule: Backend response is inert data and cannot grant authority or choose arbitrary runtime roots/commands.
semantics.configuration_rule: Alias configuration is authoritative runtime configuration, not projection/UI state.

invariants.rule: Runtime capabilities, dispatch and mutable state remain explicit, bounded and Core-governed.

hard_gates.condition: caller embeds provider/model endpoint instead of logical alias where alias semantics are required
backend response selects arbitrary runtime root or command
queue identity derived from transient provider endpoint instead of resolved alias
